name: remove-phrases
description:
Phrases of a list, found as whole words («угловой диван» is not in «угловойдиван» or «угловой диван,»).

items: the phrases to find.

Words compare in any case, ё as е; punctuation glued to a word counts. find, remove and extract take the same phrases, as the markers of your own lists: left to right, for each word the longest phrase that starts there (in words, then in characters; a tie keeps the list order), and the words of a taken phrase start no other. remove keeps the case of the other words; extract gives the phrases as the list spells them, joined by ', '.

Example: semkit read --text "купить угловой диван" remove-phrases "угловой диван" write -
-> купить

lemmas: compare the lemmas of the words (the bundled dictionary): «дешевые диваны» is «дешевый диван».

remove-phrases removes what the matcher finds from the working column.

options.name: --items
options.description: the phrases to find. Items: a comma list 'a,b', @FILE (one item per line, or the first column of a table) or @NAME of a list.

options.name: --lemmas
options.description: compare the lemmas of the words (the bundled dictionary): «дешевые диваны» is «дешевый диван».

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.

arguments.name: ITEMS
arguments.description: the phrases to find. Items: a comma list 'a,b', @FILE (one item per line, or the first column of a table) or @NAME of a list. The same as --items ITEMS.
